title.narrative: Voluntary Contribution to IRENA's Work Program and Strategy 2024 - 2026

description.narrative: IRENA’s mission is to play a leading role in the ongoing transformation of the global energy systems as a centre of excellence for knowledge and innovation, a global voice of renewable energy, a network hub for all stakeholders and a source of advice and support for countries. IRENA’s Medium-term Strategy places particular focus on enabling policy, regulatory and technical frameworks, and business models and financing instruments. Soft earmarked contributions where the countries supported under the activities will be ODA-eligible.
